sentences.text: Coram:
Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Anish Dayal

1.  This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.570/2004 PS Patel Nagar under Sections 406/498A/34 IPC, on the basis of settlement arrived at between the parties dated 21st October,
2016, arrived at through the conciliation before the Principal Judge, Family Court.

2. As per the settlement, an amount of Rs.6 Lacs was agreed to be paid to respondent No.2 on the basis of which the parties have undertaken to proceed for divorce by mutual consent and for the quashing of the FIR.
3. An amount of Rs.4 Lacs has apparently been paid to respondent No.2 and divorce has now decreed by order dated 23rd August, 2017.
However, the respondent No.2 has not presented herself in Court to receive the balance money and cooperate in the quashing as per the settlement.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 13/08/2024 at 07:29:48 4.
The parties were also sent to mediation by previous orders of this Court.
However, the mediation has failed.
5. Accordingly, Court Notice be issued to respondent No.2 to be present in Court on the next date of hearing.

6. List on 06th November, 2024.
